[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided details about the Nitto NT05's durability and tread life compared to the Michelin Pilot Sport 4 S:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - NT05 has a softer compound, relatively short tread life (5,000 to 10,000 miles of track use, 15,000 to 20,000 miles of street driving).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - Pilot Sport 4 S has a longer tread life (20,000 to 30,000 miles or more) and is more street-oriented.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] - NT05 is better for ultimate grip and handling on the track, while Pilot Sport 4 S is more versatile for both track and daily driving.
